comparison.objective: Carry an untaped-bottom carton of cans to a shelf without losing cans; unlike separating media from retained washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous underside support of articulated bottom flaps during lifting and transport versus pouring into a screen, bimanual sifting, and orientation-dependent bridge release.
comparison.success_condition: Any can leaving the carton zeros the trial; full score needs shelf placement, uprightness, release, and one-second dwell. Candidate instead intentionally passes media through apertures, retains washers, requires at least 98% recovery, no spill, supported-screen placement, and three-second dwell. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Both demand content preservation and careful bimanual handling, but one tests supporting a failing container while the other tests selective granular separation.
